apps.localizedDescription:
Madeira runs unmodified Windows PC games on an iPhone inside a single iOS app.

• FEX-Emu translates x86/x86-64 to ARM64
• Wine 11.4 (ARM64EC, WoW64 for 32-bit games)
• DXMT for Direct3D 9/10/11 on Metal
• madeira-d3d12 for Direct3D 12 on Metal

Features: game library, Steam sign-in and installs via Madeira Dock, Steam Cloud saves, Bluetooth controllers and touch controls, keyboard/mouse passthrough, Japanese locale per game.

Requires JIT (StikDebug or the built-in StikJIT helper). iOS 26+ recommended. Active research project — expect rough edges.

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.101**
Everything since 0.2.100. This is a test build and has not been tested on a device yet: please send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks.

**Controls**
• **Touch controls:** a stick zone can move the mouse, and can hold an extra action when pushed far
• **Touch controls:** buttons can latch and press a second key
• **Touch controls:** button opacity and colour
• **Gyro aim:** more activation buttons and an on-screen Gyro button
• **Touch mode:** a tap moves the pointer first, then clicks
• **Controller:** claims controller input again if the first try at app start was too early

**Game fixes**
• **Left 4 Dead 2:** downloaded Workshop add-ons are copied where the game looks for them
• **Madeira Dock:** games with no .exe launch option use the best non-beta Windows option
• Fix for the Visual C++ installer failing in some Unreal games
• **Baldur's Gate 3** launcher: room for the fourth Chromium memory pool

Thanks to BOR1NG (Avery Felts), MetalSharp-Wine (LGPL-2.1, FEX parts MIT) and Mesa/KosmicKrisp (MIT). Full source for this build is attached.

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.100**
Everything since 0.2.95. This is a test build: please send a log with Get Help for anything that breaks.

**New**
• **New look:** more screens use Apple's standard style (start screen, store pages, the "Did it work?" card, Get Help, first-time setup)
• **Controllers on iPad:** no more second (blue) highlight on menus
• **DX12 games:** newer KosmicKrisp (Mesa 26.3.1), and compiled shaders are saved, so later launches start faster
• **Steam:** the Launch arguments field now works when "The game" is picked
• **Touch camera:** with Pointer mode set to Relative, finger camera follows your sensitivity setting
• **Mouse lock (iPad):** keeps asking again if iPadOS says no at first
• **Tap to click:** better timing for taps and tap-and-hold
• **Game Dock:** finds PhysX and other installers in every Steam library, including external drives

**Game fixes**
• **Raft** reaches the main menu
• **Left 4 Dead 2** start fix
• **Baldur's Gate 3** launcher: memory and .NET fixes (still closes after about 11 s; more logs added)
• **Batman: Arkham** games reach the title screen with PhysX
• **Black Ops 3, Overwatch 2:** more logging to find their crashes

**Known issues**
• Baldur's Gate 3 and Black Ops 3 still close early
• A few games need a short hold instead of a quick tap to click

**Madeira Nightly 0.2.95 (original bundle ID, build 173)**

A nightly build for testers. It uses the original bundle ID `com.willfaust.madeora`. The complete source of this exact build is attached (`Madeira Nightly 0.2.95 og source.zip`): the Madeira tree as it was built, with the wine, FEX, DXMT and Dock folders and Madeira's own FEX and Dock patches already applied.

This build contains code ported from MetalSharp (AGPL-3.0), written by BOR1NG (Avery Felts, https://github.com/aaf2tbz): the Overwatch 2 fixes, section views, debug registers, XSAVE state revert and the opt-in Intel flag behaviour. It also contains code from MetalSharp-Wine (LGPL-2.1) and MetalSharp's FEX patches (MIT), and from Mullion (LGPL-2.1-or-later, https://github.com/dttdrv/mullion). Thank you. Details are in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and SOURCE-INFO.txt. Madeira's own code stays GPL-3.0-or-later.

Not included in the source: private keys and tokens, and the build machine's scripts.
